about: Sample signed invoices for the Mabrur agency console (/app/agen). Simulate only: each one is refused by MabrurPBM.spend on Pak Ahmad's booking with a named error. Signed by the demo vendor and agency-director keys of the live Arbitrum One deployment (two are the real invoices paid in DemoRun); tIDR is a test token with no value.

earmarkMismatch.label: Faktur hotel Ibu Siti dipakai di booking Pak Ahmad → EarmarkMismatch
earmarkMismatch.labelEn: Ibu Siti's hotel invoice used on Pak Ahmad's booking → EarmarkMismatch

vendorClaimMissing.label: Faktur hotel ditandatangani direktur agen (tanpa klaim vendor) → VendorClaimMissing
vendorClaimMissing.labelEn: Hotel invoice signed by the agency director (no vendor claim) → VendorClaimMissing

invoiceReplayed.label: Faktur hotel Pak Ahmad yang sudah dibayar, dikirim ulang → InvoiceReplayed
invoiceReplayed.labelEn: Pak Ahmad's already-paid hotel invoice, sent again → InvoiceReplayed
